title: from_content_returns_err_for_empty_username test: redundant is_err() check
description: In store.rs test from_content_returns_err_for_empty_username: result.is_err() is asserted separately, then result.err().unwrap() is called and matched. The matches!() on the unwrapped value already implies is_err(). Idiomatic rewrite: assert!(matches!(result, Err(CredentialStoreError::EmptyUsername { .. }))); — one assertion, no intermediate is_err(). Compare from_file_returns_err_for_empty_username which asserts err message content; from_content_ variant is weaker and inconsistently structured.
